about_the_game:
Blue Archive’s own Master Shiba needs your help fishing up the ingredients for his next batch of ramen! Claim this free DLC and head out to sea to complete a five-part combat mission chain—you’ll be handsomely rewarded for your efforts with a Blue Archive permanent camouflage and the Master Shiba commemorative flag.

This package includes:


  • Combat mission chain | Conditions: Complete all five parts in order playing Tier V–X ships and/or superships in any battle type except Training Battles | Rewards: 1x “Commander XP +100%” and 1x “Ship XP +100%” expendable economic bonus; 100,000 Credits; 1x Blue Archive permanent camouflage; 5,000 Elite Commander XP; 1x More Economic Rewards container; and the Master Shiba commemorative flag.

    The Blue Archive permanent camouflage can be mounted on any ship. Once mounted, the camouflage is assigned to that ship. You can have an unlimited number of Blue Archive permanent camouflages.

    This time-limited exclusive DLC is only available until August 6, 2025.
